notes: Ethereum COLLECTION launch of Worker Frens (wFREN), 2222 on-chain pixel frens. Deploy exactly PlaceFrens (src/FrensPlacement.sol, no arguments), then PlaceModules (same file, one address argument: $contract:PlaceFrens). PlaceFrens creates FrenPrices and IMD6900Frens; PlaceModules creates FrenSwapper, FrenMinter and FrenWorkerGate. WorkerArt1, WorkerArt2 and WorkerFrensRenderer belong to a separate independent ART launch and must not be bundled into this transaction. The collection launch uses about 12.3M gas all in; test_EachLaunchFitsOneTransaction accounts for creations, calldata and launcher overhead and requires 1M gas to spare below the 2^24 transaction limit. The pinned creation code in src/FrensCode.sol and salts in src/FrensPlan.sol use the standard CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920cA78FbF26c0B4956C: collection 0x69007Ce82E0BF7981780585afF7c597415903547, swapper 0x6900453deFAc8Bb12eabdcf57CCC5a14E7628AeE, minter 0xBbb2796c9C54330788915990Ba36FDDe6dC198cF, gate 0x3F8d1553Cb71C8B5af013Ce985591d9B9BCD9ce2, prices 0x8f135B75Df156e6346c8525E138bC2BD652146ff. Existing exact deployments are reused; a pre-placed swapper with its average outside the 2x spot band is replaced by a plain CREATE from PlaceModules. Always read PlaceModules.swapper(); a replacement needs its own timelock fee exemption. Without the standard deployer, the launch uses its own CREATE2 and calls no pre-existing contract. The team wallet 0x35dA9C0303507ddf708E87F2568EdDf12c47a059 is owner and governor of the collection and owner of the gate; the factory and placement contracts retain no role. Keeper, relayer and job payee remain the pinned FrensPlan values. Constructors are nonpayable, receive zero ETH and need no factory initialization calls. After both independent launches, the team runs script/frens/DeployFrens.s.sol setup() with MODULES from this launch and RENDERER from the art launch.
